caveat: When operated in FIPS mode, the tamper evident seals are installed as indicated in the Security Policy and with all interface card slots filled or covered
description: The Secure Router 4134 is a modular, multi-service branch router that combine IP routing, wide-area networking (WAN), voice/PSTN gateway and security services in a single platform. With advanced services - including IPv4/IPv6 routing, high-performance WAN, SIP survivable gateway, and IPSec VPN and firewall security - they are well-suited to address enterprise branch, regional and even headquarter WAN routing needs.
